auditTitle: SECP Cyber-Physical Authority Convergence & Canonical Identity Reconciliation Audit
verdictDescription: The QualityGate, MetrologyEngine, and Release Authority paths are proven, robust, and fail-closed against alternate certificate substitution and trust escalation attacks. However, CyberPhysicalContracts currently remains a parallel identity model isolated to test harnesses rather than acting as a direct binding layer for canonical engineering identities.
